short: the 1990s, gated by its public events (round 3)
notes: Third round on this pole (round 1 #415: 'the 1990s (in digits)', held; round 2 #832: context-gated, held, but its pagers and Macarena cue items read 0.09 and 0.03). Reason, written before this test: probes after round 2 (exploratory, none reused), each a cue sentence plus 'The shop sold 199x posters that week', show public figures, music and technology gating the unit (Clinton 0.98, Nirvana and Pearl Jam 0.71, dial-up 0.68, the Spice Girls 0.50, pagers 0.34) while toy and dance fads do not (Beanie Babies 0.02, the Macarena 0.04). So this round claims figures, music and technology, and tests the fads, a modern text and other eras as near misses. Scoring runs on a Modal L40S (bfloat16; PARITY OK on Modal).
